links.outcome: Readability of Spanish LLM-generated coaching messages compared with base model
links.effect: MHC-Coach-ES produced more temporally anchored messages than base model (65% vs. 20%) while maintaining readability.
links.quote: Linguistic analysis showed that MHC-Coach-ES produced more temporally anchored messages than the base model (65% vs. 20%), while maintaining readability.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning an LLM on Spanish health and motivational language corpus
Instruction-tuning an LLM on behavioral science framework (Transtheoretical Model) messages
Generating Spanish content natively rather than translating English human-written messages

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a fine-tuned Spanish-language LLM (MHC-Coach-ES) for physical activity coaching using human preference surveys and expert ratings, but does not test a health care deployment practice or safeguard.
